replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design states keys never expire; permanent access from leaked key is concrete attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Key in query string is in design; log/proxy leakage distinct from non-expiry."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"No rate limiting on public API supports key brute-force guessing."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Design names public endpoint with no rate limiting; flooding exhausts capacity."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"Bulk PII harvesting with valid key is distinct harm from availability or guessing."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Design names long-lived non-expiring keys per partner; attribution gap is specific."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Unscoped key granting all orders/emails is quoted; least-privilege gap distinct attack."},{"id":"T8","keep":true,"reason":"Caching of the served order/email documents is specific given credential-in-URL GET."}]}
